sqlMap.select: SELECT C.CART_ITEM_ID, C.USER_ID, C.PRODUCT_ID, C.QUANTITY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE FROM CART_ITEMS C INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON C.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #userId#
SELECT SUM(C.QUANTITY * P.PRICE) AS CART_TOTAL FROM CART_ITEMS C INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON C.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #userId#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CART_ITEMS WHERE USER_ID = #userId#
